511.body:
<!-- edda-322:inspiration-grant -->
Parent: #501; decision #322; roadmap #47. Task Size M.

One reviewable PR. Required path: this terminal -> Bard gate #501 -> #337. Additional direct qualification gates: [].

Source: pinned English SRD5.2.1 PDF31-35; exact referenced pages in scope below. SHA256 8974902d109d6e63672d7c490bde9ccf052410503d9cfa768237154fbc5e3d87. Attribution/license/adaptation: docs/srd-5.2.1-conformance.md; CC-BY-4.0. Source facts paraphrased; fixture/ownership choices are Edda additions.

Scope: PDF31-32: Bonus Action,other creature<=60ft can see OR hear Bard,one die per creature,absolute expiry1hour. Spend1 Bard use on confer;persist source/die/expiry,no roll. Existing held die not silently overwritten.

Positive deterministic fixture: Hearing-only known ally60ft receives d6 atBard1,spends1 use/Bonus Action.

Negative deterministic fixture: Reject self,61ft,neither see nor hear,existing die,unknown senses,no use/Bonus Action.

Required acceptance: For this one PR, preview is inert; explicit confirmation revalidates authoritative eligibility, source/version, target facts and expected revision. Persist choice, exact dice, once-only cost/use and history atomically. Receipt replay/retry/reload returns the same result without rerolling or charging again. Inject history failure for full rollback; race two confirmations and require one commit; stale/foreign/unsupported state rejects without mutation. Prove this with deterministic dice and isolated PostgreSQL handler/state fixtures. Disclose only player-known targets, choices, costs and source derivations; hidden/foreign facts never enter previews, receipts or errors. Shared engine serves web and TUI: explicitly expose supported choices or show unavailable with a reason on both; require desktop/phone confirmation and reconnect plus TUI behavior fixtures before availability. No Full Rules/coverage promotion. Higher-level isolated fixture state never grants production entitlement. Run GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 -short -race ./... and go vet -p 2 ./...; changed UI requires build, focused lint and behavior tests.

Feature tests use explicit isolated entitlements, never production grants. Transitions consume exact implemented contracts and apply grants once.
